root_cause.text: rxrpc only treated `skb_cloned()` skbs as unsafe for in-place decryption, so DATA/RESPONSE packets with non-cloned but externally shared paged fragments (`skb_has_frag_list()` or `skb_has_shared_frag()`) were decrypted in place and had shared frag pages bound directly into the crypto SGL in `rxrpc_input_call_event()`/`rxrpc_verify_response()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes both checks from `skb_cloned(skb)` alone to `skb_cloned(skb) || skb_has_frag_list(skb) || skb_has_shared_frag(skb)`, and the commit message says such skbs “fall through to the in-place decryption path, which binds the frag pages directly into the AEAD/skcipher SGL via `skb_to_sgvec()`.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure RXRPC data packets are unshared before in-place decryption when they contain cloned, frag-list, or shared-fragment skb data.
intent_record.what: In the RXRPC call event handler, the condition guarding packet unsharing before in-place decryption was expanded. It previously checked only `skb_cloned(skb)` and now also checks `skb_has_frag_list(skb)` and `skb_has_shared_frag(skb)` as additional reasons to unshare the skb.
intent_record.how: This changes runtime behavior so that packets with fragment lists or shared fragments are also copied/unshared before decryption modifies them in place. It prevents attempts to mutate shared or non-linear skb data structures directly, avoiding corruption or unsafe writes during RXRPC data packet processing.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure rxrpc makes a private copy before in-place decryption for cloned, fragment-list, or shared-fragment sk_buffs.
intent_record.what: The condition guarding the packet copy in `rxrpc_verify_response()` was expanded from `skb_cloned(skb)` to `skb_cloned(skb) || skb_has_frag_list(skb) || skb_has_shared_frag(skb)`, so the code now treats sk_buffs with fragment lists or shared fragments the same as cloned sk_buffs.
intent_record.how: At runtime, more packet buffer layouts will be duplicated before in-place decryption is attempted. This prevents modifying shared or fragmented skb data directly, avoiding corruption or unsafe access when the response buffer is not uniquely writable.

This check similarly limits the pre-decryption copy path to cloned sk_buffs only, missing externally shared frag data and allowing unsafe in-place decryption on shared packet contents.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition only treats cloned sk_buffs as unsafe before in-place decryption, so DATA packets with externally shared frag pages or frag lists were not copied and could be decrypted in place.
This pre-decryption safety check only covers cloned sk_buffs and misses non-cloned skbs with shared frag data, allowing unsafe in-place decryption of shared packet contents.
